title: From a new company account to a visible opportunity
summary: Understand verification, draft listings, publication and which account can see each record in ThinkMedia.
body:
A newly registered company starts with pending verification. Its saved organization details appear in the administrator's Company verification queue. A company account alone is not a student opportunity: students browse published listings from verified companies.

For an administrator: open Company verification, select the pending organization and Review it. Check its actual organization details. Choose a verification decision, provide a reason and save. Verification records the administrator and time. An administrator does not create or publish a company's opportunities.

For a verified company: open My listings and choose New listing. Enter the role title, opportunity type, location, skills, description and requirements. Save the draft. Review those details, choose Publish listing and Confirm publish. A draft stays in the company's workspace; publishing makes it eligible for student discovery and suggestions.

For a student: open Opportunities and search the actual role title, company or location. Open the listing to read its requirements. Only an open published opportunity accepts an application. If the company closes a listing, it stops accepting applications and is removed from available opportunities and suggestions. Existing applications keep their status history.

When checking different accounts, use separate browser profiles or private windows. A single browser session shares its login across tabs. Active views refresh after changes and periodically; returning to a tab also refreshes saved data. A form you are editing keeps its draft until you finish. If a request fails, check the shown error before assuming a record was saved.

These instructions describe the implemented ThinkMedia workflow (FR01, FR04, FR06 and FR11; docs/API_MARKETPLACE.md and the repository agent brief). Guidance cannot inspect a particular live account, verify an organization or publish a listing for you.

title: Apply once and follow your application in ThinkMedia
summary: Prepare the supported attachment, review a submission and understand company decisions and status history.
body:
Sign in as a student and open Opportunities. Read the listing description, location and requirements before choosing Apply to opportunity. Instructors and company accounts cannot submit student applications. A company must be verified and the listing must be published and open.

Write a relevant cover letter and attach the requested resume or requirement as a PDF up to 5 MiB. Renaming another file to .pdf does not make it valid. Check the exported PDF opens and contains the intended pages. Do not include unnecessary sensitive information. Review application shows the listing, company, letter and file before you choose Confirm and submit. One student can apply only once to a listing; a repeated submission is blocked.

After successful submission, keep the application reference and open My applications to track the saved record. Submitted means it reached the company's queue. Under review means the company changed it to that status. Accepted and Rejected are final company decisions. A company can reject a Submitted application directly, or move it to Under review and then Accept or Reject it. The Status history shows the recorded changes with Asia/Manila times.

For the company: open Applicants, select an application to your own listing, inspect the authorized documents, choose New application status, then Review status change and Confirm status change. Changes appear in the student's application record. You cannot review another company's private applicants.

The resume download is private to the submitting student and owning company. An administrator or instructor does not gain access to those documents through the general dashboards. The AI assistant receives no application record or resume and cannot know whether your individual application has been accepted. Use My applications for the actual status; contact the company through its stated process for questions outside the platform.

These instructions follow the implemented application API and role rules (FR05-FR07; docs/API_MARKETPLACE.md).
